thread:
Aisha: :wave: Quick sync — HelioThera onboarding. Renewal risk flagged as `medium` in the health dashboard; they asked for a dedicated-migration primer + a hands-on lab for their infra engineer. Can we lock an enablement slot that’s APAC-friendly (ideally overlapping APAC + US West)? I think we have two options: a single 90m session (primer + lab) or split into two 60m sessions on consecutive days. I’ll run a poll for dates/times: https://doodle.com/poll/helio-enable-abc123 — please vote by EOD tomorrow. Also note: they want recording and a short pre-read.

Liam: I can lead the migration primer portion. +1 for 90m only if we keep the lab very guided. Otherwise prefer split sessions so lab can be hands-on without rush. I’ll prepare a short preflight checklist we can share.

Nora: I’ll run the hands-on lab. For APAC-friendly, windows that work for our trainers are 04:00–06:00 UTC or 12:00–14:00 UTC. Recording planned. We should ask HelioThera if their infra engineer can do the lab host-side (SSH) or if they need us to provide a sandbox.

Diego: Strong preference for 2x60min. When we cram both into 90m we lose time for Qs and config verification. Also recommend we include a short section on cost controls and batching config — that’s often a renewal conversation.

Aisha: Good points. Poll will include both format options and ask for timezone preference. Action items from our side: collect pre-reads (model selection notes + preflight checklist), create lab sandbox instructions, draft slides for Dedicated migration. @Nora can you drop a simple runbook snippet for the lab?

Nora: Sure — here's a minimal agenda/runbook I’ll use:

```
HelioThera Enablement — Lab agenda (60m)
- 00:00–05:00 Intro + account health highlights
- 05:00–20:00 Dedicated capacity primer (Liam)
- 20:00–30:00 Cost controls & batching (Diego)
- 30:00–50:00 Hands-on lab: connect to sandbox, run a sample migration, validate KV cache behavior
- 50:00–60:00 Q&A + next steps
```

I’ll attach a `prelab.md` with SSH steps and a small sample prompt set.

Liam: Thanks — I’ll make a 10-slide deck on migration steps: pinning model versions, rollout policy, fallback routing, and rollback. Also will include a short demo of the console traces page. Anyone else from eng joining? I can invite one infra SWE.

Aisha: Invite one SWE and one solutions engineer. I’ll create the calendar invite after poll closes. Poll note: add checkbox for recording + consent and whether they want a sandbox or remote pairing. Link again: https://doodle.com/poll/helio-enable-abc123

calendar-bot: :calendar: Tentative event created (auto): "HelioThera Enablement — tentative" — 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC — will convert to final after poll closes. Invite includes Zoom + recording enabled + agenda doc link.

Diego: Added to calendar on my side. I’ll prep the batching examples and a short README for cost controls.

Nora: I’ll upload `prelab.md` and the runbook to the HelioThera shared folder and ping the customer for SSH details. Will also confirm whether they want us to provide the sandbox.

Aisha: Thanks team — aim to have poll closed and draft assets ready by EOD Friday so we can share pre-reads early next week. If anything changes ping here and I’ll update the invite. :thumbsup:
